title: General multi-turn Agent session
scenario: Evaluate a complete exported Agent session where each user turn has already been scored separately.
setup: The session ZIP manifest, per-turn exports, and per-turn Judge results are the only evidence.
user_prompt: Evaluate whether the session as a whole completed the user's work consistently across turns.

must: Use all per-turn Judge results and their evidence.
Evaluate progression, correction, and consistency across turns.
Preserve any per-turn critical failure in the session-level decision.
Consider the final workspace and final user-visible result.
Summarize aggregate token, latency, tool, handoff, permission, loop, and cache behavior.
must_not: Ignore a critical failure because later turns succeeded.
Treat repeated user turns as independent tasks without considering continuity.
Invent evidence not present in the round results or manifest.
Claim overall success when the final turn is incomplete or unverified.
